text: Approved 2026-08-29 03:16Z. Araby (Joyce, Dubliners 1914) as a narrative acceptance fixture in the WOG role (fixture policy 14c), Diagnostic origin ONLY - never Calibrated - under the contamination law (a story whose text or published summaries plausibly sit in a tested channel's training data cannot back a calibrated claim). Two properties earn it, both confirmed by the proposer and CORRECTED as to mechanism: (1) the DUAL SELF - two epistemic frames in one discourse, the boy's live desire and the adult narrator's judgment. NOT a ReaderAt/horizon test: ReaderAt is a reader-time visibility filter and Araby's diction is already adult at offset 0, so ReaderAt(early) still shows narrator judgment. It is a REPRESENTATIONAL/context test - ContextKind.Memory(holder)/Belief/Desire/Intention. If ReaderAt is treated as the whole answer, adult diction gets annotated as early reader-visible fact and the dual self is lost. (2) INTERIORITY - desire, intention, imagination, sensory affect, and an epiphany that must not become a narrated-world event; stresses the mental-state and phenomenology strands landed at a7036e9. Scope in order: (a) stress-case argument written down incl. the ReaderAt correction; (b) expectations table; (c) explicit position on whether existing ContextKind constructors suffice - a new Narrator kind is NOT a prerequisite and would need an ADR line, so do not add vocabulary before the table proves it necessary. NO STORY TEXT enters the repo until the owner signs the PD checklist; (a)-(c) need none of it.
